subject.title: fix(doctor): flag missing plugin install paths

question: Should doctor --fix remove installed-plugin records whose primary persisted installPath or sourcePath is missing, then rebuild the registry from the remaining records?
rationale: This is an intentional persisted-state repair behavior for existing user installations, so maintainer acceptance of the upgrade/operator semantics matters even though the code shape looks correct.

options.title: Accept Missing-Path Cleanup
options.body: Merge after a final base refresh if maintainers agree that absent primary install paths are stale records doctor should remove.

options.title: Ask For Broader Upgrade Proof
options.body: Request package/update survivor proof if maintainers want more than the scratch doctor CLI output before accepting the state repair.

options.title: Choose A Different Repair Contract
options.body: Pause if maintainers prefer reinstalling configured missing plugins only and leaving orphaned registry records untouched.

recommendation.title: Accept Missing-Path Cleanup
recommendation.body: Merge after a final base refresh if maintainers agree that absent primary install paths are stale records doctor should remove.
